verdicts.reason: Both share the same serious faults. The 'Find It Near You' CTA is shrunk to a tiny unreadable pill in the top corner, so the action is buried. The sage circle no longer sits behind the shoe; it floats behind the badges and headline, and the FREE DELIVERY tag collides with it. GROVE drops below the headline, which breaks the reading order. 'back' is orphaned on its own line, and a large dead area is left under the shoe. A at least keeps one clean left edge at x≈17, though its badge cluster is jammed against the top edge. B adds a top margin, but its headline and GROVE are indented about 13px from the body copy and badges, which leaves a ragged left edge, and its gaps are uneven (a big jump from GROVE to the body copy).
